used.

StudyState.description:
Study state projects the artifact trees selected by one Git commit.

``current`` maps artifact id → the revision info that is *current* for the
study. Absent key = the artifact does not exist (either never produced,
or produced-when-nonempty semantics withheld it).
StudyState.title: StudyState

StudyStatus.description: Study status reports committed artifacts, their freshness, actions, and any running one.
StudyStatus.title: StudyStatus

SummaryOperator.description:
A summary operator specifies how values within a measurement window produce one
observation.
SummaryOperator.title: SummaryOperator

TemperingDiagnostics.description: Retained tempering telemetry, separate from evidence of a production engine.
TemperingDiagnostics.title: TemperingDiagnostics

TemporalStatus.description: Temporal status states whether a construct varies within the individual over time.
TemporalStatus.title: TemporalStatus

TimelineResponse.description: Typed attempt journal returned by the study read plane.
TimelineResponse.title: TimelineResponse

TraceFunctionCall.description: The invoked tool function and its JSON argument string, retained in a trace.
TraceFunctionCall.title: TraceFunctionCall

TraceMessage.description:
A trace message records one conversational step, including any reasoning or tool
interaction.
TraceMessage.title: TraceMessage

TraceSeries.description: Every retained draw, grouped in original chain order.
TraceSeries.title: TraceSeries

TraceToolCall.description: A function invocation with the call identity used to match its result.
TraceToolCall.title: TraceToolCall

TraceUsage.description: Trace usage records the input, output, and reasoning tokens consumed by a conversation.
TraceUsage.title: TraceUsage

TrajectorySummary.description: Pointwise means and fixed 95% quantiles across generated numeric draws.
TrajectorySummary.title: TrajectorySummary

UnknownLawProvenance.description: Imported laws do not establish a conditioning history.
UnknownLawProvenance.title: UnknownLawProvenance

UploadResponse.description: An upload response identifies the stored location of an accepted data upload.
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

ValidationIssue.description:
A validation issue explains a data problem and its severity for an indicator or the
dataset.

indicator_id.description: Affected indicator; null for a dataset-wide issue.

ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue

ValidationReportArtifact.description: Data findings composed with model-dependent execution checks.

is_valid.description: Whether both the data findings and model preflight contain no failures.
is_valid.title: Is Valid

ValidationReportArtifact.title: ValidationReportArtifact

WindowExpression.description: Deterministic support-window expression that returns one scalar per window. Use Python-like syntax over source_columns with arithmetic, comparisons, if/else, and helper functions such as any(), sum(), mean(), std(), first(), last(), count_true(), count_non_null(), lower(), contains(), and contains_any(). Use None for missing values.

WorkspaceEntry.description: A workspace entry identifies an available model workspace and its research question.
WorkspaceEntry.title: WorkspaceEntry

WorkspaceList.description: A workspace list provides the available model workspaces for client navigation.
WorkspaceList.title: WorkspaceList

FactSource.description: A fact source locates supporting content within an artifact revision and records its freshness.
FactSource.title: FactSource

GitRef.description: An exact file in a study's Git object database: repository, object, and path.
GitRef.title: GitRef

SourceValidity.description: Source validity records whether a fact still matches its pinned inputs.
SourceValidity.title: SourceValidity
